name: RepaymentPosting
doc: A repayment posted against a loan account. One of the two streams Phase 0 WS-0.1.4 proves the backbone with. Source: cbs / repayment_events (config/sources/repayment_events.yaml).

fields.name: event_id
fields.doc: Producer-assigned idempotency key; consumers dedupe on it.

fields.name: loan_id
fields.doc: Normalised by lending_hub.identity.keys before any join.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.doc: Tokenized before it reaches the feature store (SRS §11.4).

fields.name: amount_minor_units
fields.doc: Integer minor units. Never a float: binary floating point cannot represent monetary decimals exactly, and the GL reconciliation is gated at 0.1%.

fields.name: value_date
fields.doc: When the payment counts against the loan.

fields.name: event_timestamp
fields.doc: When the posting happened in the source system.

fields.name: created_timestamp
fields.doc: When the platform learned it. Mandatory: without it no point-in-time join is correct (WS-0.2.1).

fields.name: posting_type
fields.doc: CBS posting code. The mapping to business meaning is a bank mapping, not an assumption.

fields.name: reversal_of_event_id
fields.doc: Set when this posting reverses an earlier one. Reversals arrive as new events; nothing is mutated in place.
